title: Nifty Crashed But IT Stocks Rallied – Why? #Shorts
description:
Bank Nifty lost 2,049 points today while TCS gained 3.53%. Here's why the market told two different stories on 23 Nov 2026.

Nifty 50 closed at 25,349.65 (-1.75%)
Bank Nifty: -3.17% (-2,049 pts)
TCS: +3.53% | IT Sector: +1.69%
Tata Steel: -8.43%

The market opened at a 9-month high (25,929) but reversed sharply as global cues from Nasdaq (-5.28%) weighed on banks and metals.
